title: Juicy Adventurous Indian Garlic Burger Bun Stir-Fry
description: A sweet and savory dish featuring juicy garlic infused inside toasted sesame seed burger buns. Boil gently to retain flavors and textures.

ingredients.name: sugar-free ketchup or sweet soy sauce

instructions: Boil the sesame seed burger buns until they're slightly soft, ensuring not to overcook them.
In a mixing bowl, mince garlic and ginger together with the chopped onion. Add salt according to your taste.
Fold in the diced tomato and finely chopped coriander leaves into the minced garlic mixture. Mix well.
Brush sesame oil on each toasted sesame seed burger bun, then spoon the mixed ingredients inside evenly.
Gently stir-fry the stuffed buns over medium heat until the juices start to seep out of the buns, about 3-5 minutes per side.
Remove from heat and let them cool slightly before serving. Optionally, drizzle with a bit more sugar-free ketchup or sweet soy sauce for added flavor.
